---
name: Bug report
about: Something looks, plays or runs wrong
labels: bug
---

**Version**
<!-- Shown in the launcher's About, and on the first lines of the log
("Red Dead Recompilation 1.1.0"). -->

**What happened**
<!-- What you saw, and what you expected instead. -->

**Where**
<!-- Chapter or Showdown stage, characters, and what was on: Story Co-op,
Play As, cheats, frame rate, mouse and keyboard or controller (which),
online (how many players). -->

**The log**
<!-- Attach Logs\last_run.log from the play folder (and Logs\previous_run.log
if the game crashed and you have started it again since). -->

**Video or screenshot** (optional, but it helps a lot)

**Your PC**
<!-- Windows version, processor, memory (RAM) and graphics card, and the
compiler the build used (Visual Studio or Clang). -->

Please do not attach game files or disc images.
